question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT wrappers by default, or should this stay an opt-in captureFilter config surface?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the durable fix sets a security default, adds or avoids plugin config surface, and changes what existing autoCapture users retain from external content.

options.title: Reject wrappers by default
options.body: Treat OpenClaw external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before shouldCapture, with memory-lancedb regression tests and docs.

options.title: Add captureFilter config
options.body: Implement the requested excludeWrapped option with schema, manifest, docs, and tests while preserving current default behavior for existing users.

options.title: Defer to provenance design
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open until broader memory trust/provenance work defines the canonical source-authority contract across storage and retrieval.

recommendation.title: Reject wrappers by default
recommendation.body: Treat OpenClaw external-content wrappers as a host-owned capture boundary before shouldCapture, with memory-lancedb regression tests and docs.
